notes.title: 🛠️ Improving Everdark
notes.notes:
[h3]🛠️ Improving Everdark – Visual & Audio Upgrades![/h3][p]The launch of [b]Everdark[/b] is getting closer, but we’re not slowing down—not even during the holidays! Our team is working hard to deliver the best possible [b]visual[/b] and [b]audio[/b] experience for you.[/p][p]Here are some of the improvements we’re bringing to the game to make it shine:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎞️ Animation Improvements[/b]
We’ve added new animations and polished the existing ones to make every movement feel smoother and more immersive.[/p][p][b]🧵 Texture Enhancements[/b]
Textures have been updated to be more detailed and visually consistent—say goodbye to low-quality or out-of-place visuals.[/p][p][b]🎧 Sound & Music Overhaul[/b]
New sound effects and music tracks have been added to enhance the atmosphere and deepen the experience.[/p][p][b]💡 Lighting Improvements[/b]
Everdark may be a dark game, but lighting matters more than ever. We’ve improved lighting quality to make shadows, contrasts, and ambiance more beautiful and dramatic.[/p][p][b]🎨 Post-Processing Upgrades[/b]
We’ve added an extra layer of post-processing to elevate the game’s overall look—Everdark has never looked better.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We hope you’ll enjoy all these updates and improvements as much as we’ve enjoyed working on them![/p][p]And this isn’t everything—we still have some surprises to reveal before launch. 👀[/p][p]➡️ [b]Add Everdark to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow us[/b] to stay updated and not miss anything![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297034/fb159f703cba22a995a32b8f1f34a46d9dae7be1.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Bloody Kitchen Unleashes Mayhem in Everdark!!!
notes.notes: [p]An action-horror game like [i]Everdark[/i] demands a sound experience as intense as its gameplay—and the audio design rises to the challenge. The majority of the game’s haunting and immersive soundtrack has been composed and produced by renowned electronic artist [b]Ratioactive[/b], whose work brings depth and atmosphere to the game’s darkest moments.[/p][p]But that’s not all.[/p][p]As passionate fans of [b]industrial metal[/b], the Everdark team wanted to inject an extra dose of raw energy into the experience. That’s why they collaborated with Madrid-based metal band [b]Bloody Kitchen[/b], who contributed a powerful, hard-hitting track for one of the game’s key stages. In addition, [b]Carlos Foak[/b], frontman of the band, composed the music for Everdark’s main menu.[/p][p]Formed in 2020 by Foak—former keyboardist of the band Ratio—[b]Bloody Kitchen[/b] blends the aggressive energy of [i]Neue Deutsche Härte[/i] with modern metal influences, drawing inspiration from legendary acts like [b]Rammstein[/b], [b]Eisbrecher[/b], and [b]Megaherz[/b]. What sets them apart: all their songs are written and performed in Spanish.[/p][p]With two acclaimed albums under their belt—[i]Degeneración[/i] (2021) and [i]Caos[/i] (2024)—the band has earned praise from critics and fans alike, with live performances that have made waves both nationally and internationally.[/p][p]And this is just the beginning. Upcoming chapters of [i]Everdark[/i] will continue to feature original music by [b]Bloody Kitchen[/b] and [b]Carlos Foak[/b], further expanding the game’s powerful sonic identity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297034/08dee2300aa943fe10ecf9cea2cc268571353f56.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🩸 The hunt has begun... Will you survive Everdark? 🧛‍♂️🔥
notes.notes:
Fight against the vampire apocalypse and reclaim the city before darkness consumes everything. Everdark: Undead Apocalypse, the highly anticipated horror FPS, is now available on Plataforms. Immerse yourself in a terrifying odyssey inspired by 80s horror cinema, blending explosive action in the style of Unreal or Doom with the gripping tension of classic survival horror.

[previewyoutube=27JMV-l7YoU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]🌑 Welcome to Everdark... if you dare 🏚️[/b]

Returning from a trip to Milwaukee turns into a nightmare when an unfortunate accident leaves the protagonist trapped in Everdark, a city devastated by chaos. Something terrible has happened: bloodthirsty vampires have taken over the streets, turning them into their hunting ground, while the few remaining survivors struggle to resist. Armed with stakes🗡️, holy water💧, firearms🔫, and melee weapons⚔️, every corner is a battle for survival. Unravel the origins of the plague and find a way out before it's too late.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297034/b1593a775e3c31d7910940f5e5035bfdbca662c9.png[/img]

The journey into darkness has begun. With its launch on Steam and other platforms, the official release trailer is here, showcasing the intense action and terrifying atmosphere awaiting in every shadow of Everdark. This is not just a shooter—it's a desperate fight for survival in a world consumed by the night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297034/14b3970eeccb647e3bf488f7be49fdb3a0d3bcdb.png[/img]

notes.title: Visit Everdark during Guerrilla Game Festival
notes.notes:
The development team is very proud to announce that EVERDARK: Undead Apocalypse 🧛‍♀️ will be at the event Guerrilla Game Festival on November 21st and 22nd, in the city of Madrid. And we will be there with no less than an [b]exclusive demo[/b] and surprises for those who dare venture into the creepy city of Everdark during the event.

We’re looking forward to seeing the audience’s reactions to this demo in person and to receiving their feedback. We hope they will have a terrific time!
